evaluation_runtime: All checkpoint and held-out physics executes on Modal. Each held-out before/after/classical triplet shares one worker.

movement_diagnostics.scope: Post-hoc physical diagnostics, not a frozen training reward. Per seed, compare the same initial window: the minimum of 20 seconds and the shortest recorded checkpoint episode.

checkpoint_retention: Starting full state is already archived. Every evaluated checkpoint uses real fixed ephemeral inference weights. Persist exactly one new full optimizer state at the development-selected stopping update, 64 or 96.
observation_representation: Independent, documented bins of observed relative target geometry. No teacher action or hidden simulator parameter. Identical encodings reuse the actual Tinker distribution from the same fixed checkpoint.
presentation_rule: Default: first declared development seed. The complete-example button is a successful test case selected after evaluation and is labeled separately.

showcase.selection: Successful test example selected after evaluation for presentation. 1/4 test routes passed; every attempt remains available.
